title: VESPER Command
description: A Command is a REQUEST that something happen. It is never proof that it happened (COC ARCH-04). Proof is a Result plus, for external effects, a reconciliation probe (REM-012 s2). Authority: IC-003, IC-009, ARCH-04; REM-003, REM-004, REM-005.

trigger_id.description: REQUIRED when actor.is_autonomous is true. INV-TRIG-1: every autonomous action traces to exactly one registered trigger.

subject_kind.description: REM-004: 'runtime' can never reach L5. L5 is the level at which the subject must be a human (INV-SELF-3).

is_autonomous.description: Determines whether DF-ACTUATION-GATE applies. User-invoked work is not gated by the emergency stop (INV-STOP-5).

args.description: Validated against the capability's declared argument schema. declared_level(args) is a FUNCTION of these values, never a constant (INV-AUTH-5).

authorization.description: The resolved output of DF-AUTHORIZE, recorded on the command so authority-at-time-of-action is reconstructible (A-018).

confirmation_ref.description: REQUIRED for L4/L5. Binds to exactly one command instance; a consumed L4 cannot authorize a second action (INV-AUTH-2).

enable_token_id.description: REQUIRED when actor.is_autonomous and effective_level >= L2. Verified fresh per action by DF-ACTUATION-GATE (INV-STOP-1). The runtime cannot mint or extend one (INV-STOP-4).

reversibility.description: REM-012: replaces IC-003's single rollback/compensation field. 'irreversible' implies L4+ and pre-commit confirmation binding.

outbox_record_id.description: REQUIRED before any external side effect. INV-EXT-1: no external effect occurs without a prior durable outbox record.

idempotency_key.description: Stable across retries. Recovery reads the outbox by this key rather than replaying the task (INV-TASK-2).

dry_run.description: IC-003 preview. A capability that cannot dry-run declares so; it does not silently execute a preview request.

allOf.$comment: INV-TRIG-1 -- an autonomous command with no trigger is malformed, not merely unaudited.
INV-AUTH-2 -- L4/L5 bind to one confirmed instance.
INV-EXT-1 -- irreversible effects require a prior outbox record.
